title.vi: Du lịch: khách sạn và sân bay

goal.vi: Nhận phòng, hỏi thông tin và nhờ giúp đỡ khi đi du lịch.
goal.en: Check in, ask for information and ask for help when you travel.

lines: Good evening! Welcome to the Riverside Hotel. How can I help you?
Hi, I have a reservation under the name Kim.
Let me see… Yes, a double room for three nights.
That's right. What time is breakfast?
From seven to ten, on the first floor.
Great. Could you tell me the Wi-Fi password?
It's on this card. Here's your key. You're in room 312.
Thanks. Could I get a late checkout on Friday?
Let me check… Yes, twelve o'clock is fine.

phrases.say: I have a reservation under the name Kim.

mean.vi: Báo với lễ tân bạn đã đặt phòng
mean.en: Tell the front desk you booked a room

why.vi: Nói cả câu "I have a reservation under the name…" – khách sạn nghe câu này mỗi ngày.
why.en: Use the full sentence "I have a reservation under the name…" – hotels hear it every day.

mean.vi: Hỏi giờ của một việc gì đó

why.vi: Bắt đầu bằng "What time is…?" khi hỏi giờ.
why.en: Start with "What time is…?" to ask about times.

phrases.say: Could you tell me the Wi-Fi password?

mean.vi: Hỏi thông tin một cách lịch sự

why.vi: "Could you tell me…?" là cách hỏi thông tin lịch sự.
why.en: "Could you tell me…?" is a polite way to ask for information.

phrases.say: Could I get a late checkout?

mean.vi: Xin trả phòng muộn hơn giờ quy định
mean.en: Ask to leave your room later than normal

why.vi: "Late checkout" là từ khách sạn dùng cho việc trả phòng muộn.
why.en: "Late checkout" is the hotel word for leaving later than normal.

phrases.say: Could I have a window seat, please?
phrases.not: I want the seat near the glass.

mean.vi: Xin chỗ ngồi cạnh cửa sổ trên máy bay
mean.en: Ask for a seat by the window on a plane

why.vi: Dùng "window seat" hoặc "aisle seat" khi làm thủ tục bay.
why.en: Use "window seat" or "aisle seat" when you check in for a flight.

phrases.not: The plane is late or not?

mean.vi: Hỏi chuyến bay có đúng giờ không
mean.en: Ask if the flight is not late

why.vi: "On time" nghĩa là đúng giờ; đây là câu hỏi quen thuộc ở sân bay.
why.en: "On time" means not late; this is the usual question at an airport.

phrases.say: Sorry, there's a problem with my room. The air conditioning isn't working.

mean.vi: Báo sự cố trong phòng một cách bình tĩnh
mean.en: Report a problem in your room calmly

why.vi: Nói rõ cái gì hỏng bằng câu đầy đủ, nhân viên sẽ giúp nhanh hơn.
why.en: Say what is wrong in a calm, full sentence, and staff can help you faster.

ai.name: Daniel
ai.goal: check the learner in and answer questions

roleplay.you: Check in, ask about breakfast or Wi-Fi, and ask for a late checkout.

turns.a: Good evening! Welcome to the Riverside Hotel. How can I help you?
turns.h: Hi, I have a reservation under the name Kim.
br: Let me check that for you.

turns.a: Yes, I see it: a double room for three nights. Can I see your passport, please?
Here's your key. You're in room 312. Do you have any questions?
br: Breakfast is from seven to ten.
The Wi-Fi password is on your key card.

turns.a: Is there anything else I can help you with?
turns.h: Could I get a late checkout on Friday?
br: late checkout|late check-out|check out later|stay later
Let me see… yes, twelve o'clock is fine.

roleplay.end: Enjoy your stay! Have a good night.
